verdict.rationale: Kling's own homepage lists "MCP / CLI" as a way to let agents drive Kling, which is a first-party claim of an official CLI. It is only a single marketing headline, and nothing in the pack documents the CLI itself. Missing for 10: CLI installation and distribution docs, command reference, authentication and usage examples, agent-workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
